questions.question: When should you use StringBuilder instead of concatenation with `+`?
options: When building strings in loops or concatenating more than 3-4 parts
Only when working with strings longer than 1000 characters
StringBuilder is deprecated, never use it
explanations: For 2-3 concatenations, + is more readable and the compiler optimizes it.
Correct. In loops, each + creates a new String object. StringBuilder modifies a single object, avoiding intermediate garbage.
Size is not the deciding factor; it is the number of operations.
StringBuilder is still relevant for efficient construction.
